title: Luxury white tote bag ad
text: A studio-style turntable reveal of a white leather tote. Spec ad, not affiliated with the brand shown
idea: Luxury product video without a studio: soft light, a clean set and a slow turn that shows shape, stitching and hardware.
why: Soft light shows the leather texture.
A slow turn shows every angle of the bag.
A clean set keeps the focus on the product.
